cases.purpose: fsck and fsck -v on a loop block device holding an mke2fs ext2 filesystem report clean status 0, and the verbose summary and stdout fields equal the dumpe2fs values.
cases.oracle: dumpe2fs -h (e2fsprogs) of the same image gives inode/block counts and blocks-per-group; state bytes and unchanged-device checks use SHA-256 of the first 8 KiB read independently with Python; expected status codes per the fsck header (0 clean, 4 uncorrected, 8 operational).
cases.comparison: Candidate output, status and files compared with values derived independently of candidate output.
cases.script:
. ./rl.sh
/usr/bin/truncate -s 4M f.img
$MK -q -t ext2 -b 1024 -L FSCKDEV f.img
dump=$(/usr/sbin/dumpe2fs -h f.img 2>/dev/null)
get() { local k=$1 l; v=; while IFS= read -r l; do [[ $l == "$k:"* ]] && { v=${l#*:}; v=${v#"${v%%[![:space:]]*}"}; return; }; done <<<"$dump"; }
get "Inode count"; ino=$v; get "Block count"; blk=$v; get "Blocks per group"; bpg=$v; groups=$(((blk+bpg-1)/bpg))
sha() { /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import hashlib,sys;print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],"rb").read(8192)).hexdigest())' "$1"; }
at f.img; L=$REPLY
fsck -v $L >o.txt 2>e.txt; echo "verbose status=$?"
[[ $(< o.txt) == "$L: clean, ext2, $ino inodes $blk blocks" ]] && echo stdout=match || echo "stdout=differ [$(< o.txt)]"
[[ $(< e.txt) == "$L: variant=ext2 block_size=1024 blocks=$blk inodes=$ino groups=$groups state=0x0001 rev=1 label=\"FSCKDEV\"" ]] && echo summary=match || echo "summary=differ [$(< e.txt)]"
fsck $L >o.txt 2>e.txt; echo "plain status=$? stderr-empty=$([[ -s e.txt ]] && echo no || echo yes)"
cases.stdout:
verbose status=0
stdout=match
summary=match
plain status=0 stderr-empty=yes

cases.purpose: On a block device with the ERRORS bit set, fsck without -p exits 4 leaving the device bytes unchanged; fsck -p clears only s_state through the device node, the change persists in the backing file, and a later check is clean.
cases.oracle: dumpe2fs -h (e2fsprogs) of the same image gives inode/block counts and blocks-per-group; state bytes and unchanged-device checks use SHA-256 of the first 8 KiB read independently with Python; expected status codes per the fsck header (0 clean, 4 uncorrected, 8 operational).
cases.comparison: Candidate output, status and files compared with values derived independently of candidate output.
cases.script:
. ./rl.sh
/usr/bin/truncate -s 4M f.img
$MK -q -t ext2 -b 1024 -L FSCKDEV f.img
dump=$(/usr/sbin/dumpe2fs -h f.img 2>/dev/null)
get() { local k=$1 l; v=; while IFS= read -r l; do [[ $l == "$k:"* ]] && { v=${l#*:}; v=${v#"${v%%[![:space:]]*}"}; return; }; done <<<"$dump"; }
get "Inode count"; ino=$v; get "Block count"; blk=$v; get "Blocks per group"; bpg=$v; groups=$(((blk+bpg-1)/bpg))
sha() { /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import hashlib,sys;print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],"rb").read(8192)).hexdigest())' "$1"; }
/usr/bin/python3 - f.img <<'PY'
import struct, sys
fh = open(sys.argv[1], "r+b"); fh.seek(1024 + 58); fh.write(struct.pack("<H", 2)); fh.close()
PY
/usr/bin/cp f.img orig.img
at f.img; L=$REPLY
h0=$(sha $L)
fsck $L >o.txt 2>e.txt; rc=$?
[[ $(< e.txt) == "$L: s_state has ERRORS bit set (0x0002); rerun with -p or -y to clear" ]] && m=message || m="other:$(< e.txt)"
echo "no-repair status=$rc $m unchanged=$([[ $(sha $L) == "$h0" ]] && echo yes || echo no)"
fsck -p $L >o.txt 2>e.txt; rc=$?
[[ $(< o.txt) == "$L: cleared dirty bit (s_state 0x0002 -> 0x0001), ext2, $ino inodes $blk blocks" ]] && m=message || m="other:$(< o.txt)"
echo "preen status=$rc $m"
/usr/bin/sync
/usr/bin/python3 - orig.img f.img <<'PY'
import sys
a = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read(8192); b = open(sys.argv[2], "rb").read(8192)
print("changed-offsets-in-backing-file=" + ",".join(str(i) for i in range(len(a)) if a[i] != b[i]))
PY
fsck $L >o.txt 2>e.txt; echo "after-repair status=$?"
cases.stdout:
no-repair status=4 message unchanged=yes
preen status=0 message
changed-offsets-in-backing-file=1082
after-repair status=0

cases.purpose: An unreadable device node (uid 2000 against a root-owned 0660 loop node) and a missing node give operational status 8 with the errno text; root reads the same node with status 0.
cases.oracle: dumpe2fs -h (e2fsprogs) of the same image gives inode/block counts and blocks-per-group; state bytes and unchanged-device checks use SHA-256 of the first 8 KiB read independently with Python; expected status codes per the fsck header (0 clean, 4 uncorrected, 8 operational).
cases.comparison: Candidate output, status and files compared with values derived independently of candidate output.
cases.script:
. ./rl.sh
/usr/bin/truncate -s 4M f.img
$MK -q -t ext2 -b 1024 -L FSCKDEV f.img
dump=$(/usr/sbin/dumpe2fs -h f.img 2>/dev/null)
get() { local k=$1 l; v=; while IFS= read -r l; do [[ $l == "$k:"* ]] && { v=${l#*:}; v=${v#"${v%%[![:space:]]*}"}; return; }; done <<<"$dump"; }
get "Inode count"; ino=$v; get "Block count"; blk=$v; get "Blocks per group"; bpg=$v; groups=$(((blk+bpg-1)/bpg))
sha() { /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import hashlib,sys;print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],"rb").read(8192)).hexdigest())' "$1"; }
at f.img; L=$REPLY
/usr/bin/setpriv --reuid=2000 --regid=2000 --clear-groups "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "fsck $L" >o.txt 2>e.txt; rc=$?
[[ $(< e.txt) == *"open $L: Permission denied" ]] && m=eacces || m="other:$(< e.txt)"
echo "unreadable-node status=$rc $m"
fsck /dev/loop-no-such-node >o.txt 2>e.txt; rc=$?
[[ $(< e.txt) == *"No such file or directory" ]] && m=enoent || m="other:$(< e.txt)"
echo "missing-node status=$rc $m"
fsck $L >o.txt 2>e.txt; echo "root-readable status=$?"
cases.stdout:
unreadable-node status=8 eacces
missing-node status=8 enoent
root-readable status=0
